purpose: Deterministic display-only reconstruction of three representative MetaShift-Bench event cases. This configuration changes only the presentation window and does not change any frozen estimator, threshold, donor rule, or scientific result.

supported_candidate.rule: Select the anchor minimizing absolute distance between standardized_score and the within-tier median standardized_score; break ties by anchor_id ascending.

not_supported.rule: Select the anchor minimizing absolute distance between standardized_score and the within-tier median standardized_score; break ties by anchor_id ascending.

inconclusive_missing_counterfactual.rule: Select the lexicographically first anchor_id. The panel must show the target series and the machine-readable abstention reason without imputing a counterfactual.

reconstruction.weight_fit: Use the frozen inclusive calibration slice t0-180 through t0-15 and the fixed 0.1 ridge plus 0.1 reliability-prior penalties.
reconstruction.effect_check: Recomputed log_effect must match the saved metashift_v1_fixed result within absolute tolerance 1e-9.
reconstruction.placebo_display: The frozen summary supplies placebo count, observed standardized score, placebo median score, and upper-tail probability. Per-date placebo-score distributions are not included in the frozen release input list and must not be reconstructed or simulated for the figure.
